answer: Start with Slow-start reputation that cannot be bought. The idea is simple: reputation that only grows one epoch at a time, and that sparrow alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since reputation that only grows one epoch at a time takes calendar time as well as money — and the tide is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. The price is not in coins but in friction: each fake needs its own reputation that only grows one epoch at a time, and the basalt of that friction is a hundred small errands no script can automate away.
